prompt: Standard input contains exactly two signed decimal integers separated by whitespace. Print their sum as one decimal integer followed by a newline.
Standard input contains one decimal integer n between 0 and 12 inclusive. Print n factorial, where 0 factorial is 1.
Standard input consists of one to five nonempty ASCII lines and ends with a newline. Print the same lines in reverse order, preserving the text of each line, with a final newline.
Standard input is ASCII text that may contain spaces, tabs and newlines. Print the count of whitespace-delimited words as a decimal integer, with a newline. An empty input contains zero words.
Read all standard input as UTF-8 text. Remove whitespace at both ends, lowercase the remaining text using normal Unicode lowercase rules, and print the result followed by a newline.
Standard input contains one line with 1 to 10 signed decimal integers separated by commas. There may be spaces around each number. Print the sum followed by a newline.
